instruction: Enhance the image to 8K resolution with AI-driven super resolution, preserving maximum clarity and detail.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP lacks AI-powered super resolution capabilities. While GIMP can scale images up, it uses traditional interpolation algorithms (cubic, linear, etc.) that cannot genuinely enhance detail or achieve the quality claimed by AI super resolution models. True super resolution requires deep learning models that GIMP does not have integrated.
metadata.infeasibility_reason: GIMP does not have AI super resolution; only has basic interpolation upscaling

llm_judge_reasons: Infeasible task correctly uses 'infeasible' evaluator function
